title: Long-term training continually fine tunes motor memories
title_zh: 长期训练不断精细调节运动记忆
abstract: Humans’ rapid adaptation to new dynamics is a crucial ability for interacting with the world. By combining the controlled manipulations of sensorimotor adaptation studies with the long-term learning approach of complex tasks, this study shows that the learned motor memory is continually tuned, and that retention increases with long-term training.
abstract_zh: 人类快速适应新动力学是与世界交互的关键能力。本研究将感运动适应研究的控制操控与复杂任务长期学习方法相结合，表明习得的运动记忆不断受到精细调节，且长期训练可提高保持能力。
